findings.title: Proceeds from Disposals has no plan data

findings.title: Add Termination & Delivery Cost % of Revenue
findings.detail: Termination & Delivery Cost has no ratio KPI — common in EPM reporting packs.
findings.prompt: Add a new KPI "Termination & Delivery Cost % of Revenue" = cogs / rev * 100.

findings.title: Messaging & Platform Revenue (Billed Traffic, SaaS & Payment Fees) moved EUR -13.38B vs Budget

findings.prompt: Explain the EUR -13.38B movement in Messaging & Platform Revenue (Billed Traffic, SaaS & Payment Fees) between Budget and Q3 Forecast and its impact through to EBITDA and Net Income.
